summary: Frees a heap array of overlay/sprite entries stored at this + 0x9B0. If the pointer is non-null, reads the entry count from the header dword at (array - 4), walks the array backward calling QuadrupleListCleanup on each 44-dword (176-byte) entry, frees the header block via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zeroes the pointer at this + 0x9B0 and the count at this + 0x9B4. Returns the freed pointer value (zero on the normal path).

operations.description: Read the array pointer result from this + 0x9B0 (this[620]).
Guard on the array pointer being non-null: if it is zero, skip the whole cleanup and return.
Read the element count v3 from the header dword at (array - 4) and set v4 to the header pointer (array - 4).
Compute v5 = array + 176*v3 (one entry past the last 176-byte entry).
Guard on (v3 - 1) >= 0; when the count is zero the walk is skipped entirely.
do-while loop walking the entries backward (v5 -= 44 dwords = 176 bytes each iteration) for v3 iterations.
Per entry: call QuadrupleListCleanup on the entry at v5.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the header pointer v4 (array - 4) to release the allocation.
Write this + 0x9B0 (this[620]) to zero to clear the array pointer.
Write this + 0x9B4 (this[621]) to zero to clear the count field.

Entry layout and the resource semantics handled by QuadrupleListCleanup per 176-byte entry are unknown.
